summary_en: Payout ratio raised from 40% to 50%; DOE (dividend-on-equity) floor of 5% introduced. Policy applies from Q2 FY3/27. FY3/27 annual dividend guidance revised upward to ¥100/share (¥50 interim + ¥50 final) from prior ¥80/share guidance. Minimum annual dividend floor set at forward guidance level.
title_en: Notice on Changes to Dividend Policy (Increase in Payout Ratio, Introduction of DOE) and Revision to Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: Sankyo announced on 6 August 2026 a revision to its dividend policy and an upward revision to dividend forecasts. The company raised its target payout ratio from 40% to 50% of consolidated net income and introduced a dividend-on-equity (DOE) floor of 5%, applying whichever is higher. The new policy takes effect from the Q2 FY3/27 interim dividend. Additionally, management set the prior-year forward guidance as a minimum annual dividend floor to enhance stability and predictability. The FY3/27 annual dividend forecast was raised to ¥100 per share (¥50 interim + ¥50 final) from the prior guidance of ¥80 per share. The previous year (FY3/26) paid ¥90 per share (¥45 interim + ¥45 final). The revision was approved at a board meeting held on the announcement date.
